GENERAL_INFO.WINDSCREEN:
This extra coverage covers the repair and/or replacement cost to windscreen, window, sunroof, lamination and/or tinted film damages without compromising your Non Claim Discount benefit.

You may set the preferred sum insured value based on the range of sum insured recommendation made by respective insurer.
GENERAL_INFO.LEGAL_LIABILITY: This extra coverage covers you against legal liabilities in the event that you are faced with legal action sought by your passenger(s) against you.
GENERAL_INFO.SPECIAL_PERIL: This extra coverage covers your vehicle against loss or damage caused by natural perils such as flood, hurricane, storm, volcanic eruption, earthquake, landslide, subsidence or sinking of the soil/earth and/or other natural perils.
GENERAL_INFO.LEGAL_LIABILITY_2: This extra coverage covers you against a third party claim against you for the negligence of your passengers. For example, damage to another vehicle when your passenger(s) open your car door.
GENERAL_INFO.VEHICLE_ACCESSORIES:
This extra coverage covers your vehicle accessories such as disc player, dashboard camera, etc. against loss or damage, without compromising your Non Claim Discount benefit.

It can be seen that accessories coverage is extremely useful and advisable to purchase in order to protect your expensive and valuable car accessories in case of damage or theft.
GENERAL_INFO.MPA:
This extra coverage covers you, any Authorised Drivers and your passengers against personal injury, death and any medical expenses incurred due to road accident.

Road accidents and their degree of repercussions may vary, ranging from no to minor injury to loss of life. Protect yourself and your loved ones by getting this extra coverage.
GENERAL_INFO.BETTERMENT_BUYBACK: By buying this cover you will not be required to pay any amount towards your car's betterment if new original parts are used to repair your car.
GENERAL_INFO.SRCC: Get covered against loss or damages to your car in the event of strikes, riots, and civil commotions.
GENERAL_INFO.CART:
This extra coverage compensates you up to 21 days for the number of days required (assessed by Allianz) to repair your damaged car.

The compensation amount will be based on the rate per day and number of days that you have chosen for this add-on at the point of purchase.
GENERAL_INFO.CAR_BREAKIN:
This extra coverage reimburses you the actual expenses incurred up to RM500, to repair or replace your personal effects that were in your car if they are lost or damaged due to a break-in committed by way of actual forcible and violent entry into your car, or armed robbery or robbery with threatened violence, whilst you are in your car. This benefit is limited to one claim only during the period of insurance of your policy.

Personal effects shall comprise the following: Smart Tag, Touch n Go card, National Registration Identity Card (NRIC), driver’s license, credit cards or charge cards, access cards, eye glasses, personal electronic devices (such as mobile phone, power bank, tablet, laptop, camera), wallet, handbag, purse, keys (except keys to your car) and shoes.
GENERAL_INFO.KEY_CARE: This extra coverage reimburses you the actual expenses up to RM1,000, to replace one set of car key if your car key is lost, stolen or damaged due to theft or attempted theft or house break-in that is committed by way of actual forcible and violent entry, or armed robbery or robbery with violence.
GENERAL_INFO.ROAD_RANGERS: This extra coverage is a nationwide motor accident assistance provided free-of-charge to all Allianz Motor Comprehensive (Private Car) policyholders.
GENERAL_INFO.BETTERMENT_WAIVER: By buying this cover you will not be required to pay any amount towards your car's betterment if new original parts are used to repair your car.
GENERAL_INFO.WINDSCREEN_LONPAC:
This extra coverage covers the repair and/or replacement cost to windscreen, window, sunroof, lamination and/or tinted film damages without compromising your Non Claim Discount benefit.

You may set the preferred sum insured value based on the range of sum insured recommendation made by respective insurer.

You will receive a special advantage when insuring with Lonpac: if your windscreen is repaired instead of replaced, the sum insured for your windscreen will be automatically reinstated to the original amount without any additional premium.
GENERAL_INFO.UNLIMITED_TOWING: In the event your vehicle is immobilized due to breakdown/accident, the Insurer will extend their Auto Partner roadside assistance to provide unlimited towing distant within Malaysia to a panel workshop. Up to 3 times per duration of the policy in forced.
GENERAL_INFO.NCD_RELIEF: Compensates you for the NCD that you may forfeit due to a claim being made, the amount is the equal to your NCD entitlement stated in the policy schedule for the current period insurance.
GENERAL_INFO.WINDSCREEN_TOKIOMARINE: Covers the cost to replace or repair any glass in the windscreen, window or sunroof of your vehicle that is accidentally damaged, including the cost of lamination/tinting film (if any)
GENERAL_INFO.SPECIAL_PERIL_TOKIOMARINE:
Covers the loss or damage to your car caused by flood, typhoon, hurricane, storm, tempest, volcanic eruption, earthquake, landslide, landslip, subsidence or sinking of the soil/earth or other convulsions of nature. 

The Insurer will pay the cost of repair if your car is repairable. If your car is total loss, the amount payable will be the Market Value at the time of the loss or the Sum Insured as shown in the Schedule, whichever sum is the lesser.
GENERAL_INFO.SPECIAL_PERIL_LONPAC:
This extra coverage covers your vehicle against loss or damage caused by natural perils such as flood, hurricane, storm, volcanic eruption, earthquake, landslide, subsidence or sinking of the soil/earth and/or other natural perils.

In addition, if your car cannot be driven as a result of any damage due the above mentioned, the Insurer will reimburse you up to a maximum of RM600 under the policy for the towing cost (excluding toll charges and any repair cost) to remove your car to the nearest approved repairer or to a safe place of storage while awaiting repair or disposal.
